parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view your instance ID.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

parameters.name: JobCode
parameters.description: The ID of the push task. The **Data** field returned after you call [PushSpeech](~~217573~~) is the push task ID.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.
